finding: The geometry-supported conflict recovery (--geometry-guided-conflict-recovery, recover_conflict_tracks_geometry) improves the connected-run mapper over the union-find default when the candidate/matching stages are held fixed: it registers more images at 1k/5k/10k, roughly neutral at 2.5k, and consistently lowers mean reprojection and raises track count. The 10k registration rises 199 -> 213, but the scale collapse (1.2k plateau) is not resolved by this change alone.

change.detail: Expose --geometric-confidence-tracks, --cycle-supported-tracks and --geometry-guided-conflict-recovery and pass them into build_mapper_command. Previously only --confidence-ordered-tracks was reachable from the runner; the example already implemented the other track strategies.

method: Mapping-only A/B on the frozen M5 verified-pair snapshots (candidate generation and matching held fixed), so the comparison isolates the mapper/track-builder. Command template is the frozen tier mapping command with --geometry-guided-conflict-recovery appended for the treatment arm.
caveat: The frozen M5 mapping wall figures (tier-5000: 2:53) no longer hold for current main, whose mapper is roughly 10x slower on the same snapshot (tier-5000 baseline 30:14). The registered-fraction and reprojection deltas above are current-code vs current-code and are therefore valid A/B; absolute walls are not comparable to the M5 report.
decision: Adopt --geometry-guided-conflict-recovery for the connected-run mapper: it is neutral-to-positive on registration and consistently improves reprojection/track support. The 10k registration remains far below the 1.2k plateau, so the scale problem persists and is not solved by this switch alone.
